deployments_detail.use: AI platform agreement with Microsoft (Azure OpenAI Service) to accelerate battery materials R&D; company reports its first AI-enabled patent filings in battery materials
deployments_detail.value: first AI-enabled patents filed in battery materials

deployments_detail.use: Battery materials R&D acceleration platform: a proprietary, IP-secured AI environment built on Microsoft Azure OpenAI that ingests decades of Umicore's research data plus simulations, experiments and images to help scientists design new cathode/battery materials faster. Umicore says it has filed AI-enabled patents for battery materials. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service]
deployments_detail.value: CEO projects battery-materials research cycle cut from ~6 years to ~2 years (projection, per The Chemical Engineer)

deployments_detail.use: AI algorithms to model metal-to-air emission behavior by combining emission-monitoring, weather (wind speed/direction) and production data, so operations can be adjusted more quickly/accurately to reduce diffuse emissions (complements CFD modeling and X-ray fluorescence monitoring).
deployments_detail.value: none (broader 45% diffuse-emission reduction by 2022 attributed mainly to operational excellence, not the AI specifically)

deployments_detail.use: Generative-AI and Agentic-AI industrial solutions program (based in Hanau, precious-metals/catalysis site) developing and deploying next-generation GenAI and agentic systems for industrial use cases, using frameworks such as LangChain/Strands. [LangChain / Strands (frameworks cited)]

'AI for Science' R&D initiative applying machine learning and generative AI to accelerate scientific knowledge discovery and materials/catalysis development across established ML, deep learning and modern generative-AI methods.
AI platform for battery materials research and development acceleration [Microsoft]
AI algorithms to model emission behavior from production data

Microsoft 365 Copilot enterprise generative-AI assistant rolled out via a structured 8-month pilot (300 licenses across every business unit and geographies incl. Brussels, Shanghai, Kobe), with community-management program (Copilot Cafés, webinars) driving adoption; moving to broader rollout. [Microsoft 365 Copilot]
deployments_detail.value: ~90% of testers reported increased productivity; >90% did not want to give up their license (300 licenses, 8-month pilot)

deployments_detail.use: Internal AI agents proof-of-concept: Umicore built and compared three PoC autonomous AI agents on real enterprise data, spanning meeting preparation, project status reporting and resourcing decisions, to explore reshaping internal knowledge-work workflows.

AI-powered chat assistant embedded in the 2025 Annual Report, letting readers query the report conversationally to find information (deployed reader-facing feature on investor-relations publications).

Corporate data-science team (Umicore Corporate Research, Olen) develops and deploys machine-learning models for customer segmentation, recommendation systems, anomaly detection and predictive analytics against enterprise/business data.
